$comment: Permission allow-list for the interactive session flow. Union this into the repo's existing .claude/settings.json permissions.allow — never replace the file. Both invocation shapes are listed for each script: a vendored harness runs it as scripts/<name>, and the plugin runs it through an absolute ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} path. Bash rules match by prefix, so a multi-line block that opens with a variable assignment can still prompt; that is expected — this list removes the common single-command prompts, it is not a claim that nothing will ever ask. No hooks here on purpose: session clones commit deliberately, so any auto-commit-on-stop hook belongs in the gitignored settings.local.json.
